subsystems.name: Prospect data layer
subsystems.role: holds the accounts and people the agent is allowed to contact, and the signals that make them worth contacting now.
parts: enrichment data (firmographics, tech stack, hiring and funding signals)

subsystems.name: Agent core
subsystems.role: decides what to do next: which account, which person, what to say, when to stop.
parts: large language model with tool use
short-term memory of the current thread

subsystems.name: Grounding and knowledge
subsystems.role: keeps claims tied to something true about the product and the buyer.
parts: retrieval index over product docs and case studies
prior email threads and CRM notes

subsystems.name: Outreach delivery
subsystems.role: actually gets messages into inboxes and reads what comes back.
parts: sending domains with SPF, DKIM and DMARC records

subsystems.name: Scheduling
subsystems.role: turns a positive reply into a confirmed meeting without a human.

subsystems.name: Guardrails and compliance
subsystems.role: prevents illegal, dishonest or brand-damaging messages and caps the damage when the model errs.
parts: per-law rules (opt-in regimes, unsubscribe deadlines, disclosure of automated contact)

subsystems.name: Evaluation and oversight
subsystems.role: measures whether the agent is helping and hands off when it shouldn't continue.

buildSteps.title: Define the target and the outcome
buildSteps.detail: Write down exactly which accounts and roles the agent may contact, and what counts as success — a reply, a booked meeting, a qualified opportunity.

buildSteps.title: Connect and clean the data
buildSteps.detail: Sync the CRM through its API, enrich each account, verify that addresses are deliverable, and de-duplicate against existing contacts and customers.

buildSteps.title: Ground the model
buildSteps.detail: Build a retrieval index over product documentation, pricing rules, case studies and past winning threads, so the agent quotes real facts rather than inventing them.

buildSteps.title: Define the tool set
buildSteps.detail: Give the agent callable functions with strict schemas: search accounts, fetch a contact, draft a message, check calendar availability, create a booking, write back to the CRM.

buildSteps.title: Wire the control loop
buildSteps.detail: The agent plans a step, calls a tool, drafts a message, critiques it against the guardrails, then either sends it or queues it for a human.

buildSteps.title: Build compliant sending infrastructure
buildSteps.detail: Register dedicated sending subdomains, publish authentication records, warm the domains gradually over weeks, and enforce unsubscribe and suppression checks on every send.

buildSteps.title: Add measurement and gating
buildSteps.detail: Score replies and meetings automatically, compare against a human baseline, and route anything below a confidence threshold to a person instead of sending.

buildSteps.title: Run, audit and retune
buildSteps.detail: Feed reply outcomes back into prompts and retrieval, review a sample of transcripts weekly, and adjust volume, tone and targeting as deliverability or quality drifts.

prerequisites.tech: Large language models with reliable tool use
prerequisites.why: the agent must decide and act through APIs, not just produce text.
the agent reads and writes records and books time through them.
without them bulk automated mail is filtered or blocked outright.
consent, disclosure and unsubscribe obligations are legally binding in many markets.
judging whether a message is accurate, on-brand and welcome is still hard to automate.
misreading a 'not now' as a 'yes' wastes the very time the agent was meant to save.

pathway.milestone: single-channel email agents that draft and send within tight guardrails, with humans approving first contact
pathway.unlocks: less manual list-building and follow-up for sales teams.

pathway.milestone: multi-channel agents handling voice, messaging and social outreach with shared memory
pathway.unlocks: consistent follow-up across whichever channel a buyer uses.

pathway.milestone: closed-loop optimisation against CRM outcomes rather than reply rates
pathway.unlocks: targeting and messaging tuned to revenue, not vanity metrics.

pathway.milestone: buyer-side agents filtering and negotiating inbound offers
pathway.unlocks: a shift toward agent-to-agent prospecting, which will force new norms on disclosure and consent.
